properties.evidence: Opposing, and worth stating rather than smoothing over: that capability's whole premise is asking by DECLARED level 'instead of deriving it from the containment spine', and option B here proposes exactly the derivation it rejected. The disagreement is narrower than it looks — its rejection rests on a measurement of an INCOMPLETE spine (14 components with no parent), not on depth being a bad definition of level — but it is a real conflict about which of two sources is authoritative, and the design will have to pick if B is ever taken.
